use_logger_info: use the flowdec log object to log an info message to the meta.flowdec logger
use_logger_debug: use the flowdec log object to log a debug message after setting the level to DEBUG
use_logger_warning: use the flowdec log object to log a warning message about a potential issue
use_logger_error: use the flowdec log object to log an error message when an exception occurs
configure_logger_level: configure the flowdec log object level to DEBUG for verbose output during development
